body:
### Summary

Dev builds of Python 3.14 and earlier have a version ending in `+`:

```console
❯ ./python.exe --version
Python 3.14.8+
```

And uvx runs tools fine:

```console
❯ uvx --python ./python.exe pycowsay hello

  -----
< hello >
  -----
   \   ^__^
    \  (oo)\_______
       (__)\       )\/\
           ||----w |
           ||     ||
```

However, dev builds of 3.15 onwards have a vesion ending in `+dev`:

```console
❯ ./python.exe --version
Python 3.16.0a1+dev
```

This was to make them compatible with PEP 508 versions: https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/99968.

But uvx isn't happy:

```console
❯ uvx --python ./python.exe pycowsay hello
error: Failed to spawn: pycowsay
  cause: No such file or directory (os error 2)
```

Reproducible with 3.15 and 3.16, and other tools such as tox, and on Ubuntu on GitHub Actions.


### Platform

macOS 15 (Darwin 24.6.0) arm64; also Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64 on GitHub Actions

### Version

uv 0.13.6 (329bf9448 2026-10-26 aarch64-apple-darwin); also uv 0.12.23 on Linux

### Python version

Python 3.16.0a1+dev
title: `uvx` "Failed to spawn" on CPython dev builds with `+dev` version suffix
